length cap and the stream is not at EOF, and the bytes it read STAY on the
stream. Measured on `php -n` 8.5.6 over a non-blocking socket pair: writing "abc"
with no newline answers `false`, and once "def\n" arrives the next call answers
"abcdef". elephc consumed the "abc" and answered it — so a reader assembling
